description: Registered tiling strategies. `arrangement` is the sole store; its module is a pure jq program evaluated by the proposal adapter under the exclusive transaction lease against checkpoint state and one trusted world. The manifest remains an explicit extension seam: a future strategy adds one sibling module, one entry, and its config. The arrangement config owns re-equalization, newcomer homing/classification, crowding, and reclaim policy. Lifecycle and membership proposals own newcomer decisions, float pins, and removal reclaim before the strategy runs. `LEYLINE_PARCEL_FLOAT_FRAC` is a legacy hydration input, default 0.6, imported once into the checkpoint-owned `float_fraction`. That fraction and `front_center_on_manual_float` affect only an interactive manual toggle from tiled to floated; programmatic `float on` preserves caller-owned placement. A strategy declares only the knobs it consumes.
